name: Brand & Creative
tagline: Brands people remember and content people stop for.
description: Identity, design, reels, films and product imagery — the look, voice and assets that make a brand recognisable on every surface, from a favicon to a hoarding.
intro: Brand & Creative is the gaa-tha practice that decides what a brand looks, sounds and feels like — and then makes the assets: identity systems, graphic design, reels, AI ads, cinema films, product photography, copy and sales kits. Every service below is delivered by the same in-house team, so the story stays consistent across all of them.

faq.q: What does a brand and creative agency do?
faq.a: A brand and creative agency defines how a business looks, sounds and behaves (identity, tone, guidelines) and produces the creative that carries it: social content, reels, ad films, packaging, catalogues and product imagery. gaa-tha runs both halves under one roof so the identity and the daily content never drift apart.

faq.q: Do I need branding before I start marketing?
faq.a: Usually yes, at least a minimum viable identity: a logo, colours, type and a tone of voice. Marketing spends money to make people notice you; branding decides what they remember. If you already have an identity that works, we build on it rather than replacing it.

faq.q: Can you produce creative at volume every month?
faq.a: Yes. Reels, graphic design and AI imagery run on monthly retainers with a content calendar, and our AI-assisted production pipeline lets us ship batches in days. Art direction stays human so the output looks like your brand, not like a template.

faq.q: Do you do real shoots as well as AI-generated creative?
faq.a: Both. We plan and direct on-ground shoots for reels and films, produce AI ad shoots when speed or SKU count makes a physical shoot impractical, and often blend the two.

faq.q: Which industries is this for?
faq.a: FMCG and food, D2C beauty, retail, manufacturing and B2B, real estate and education are the categories we work in most. The process is the same; the references and channels change.

name: Growth Marketing
tagline: Strategy, content and ads that turn attention into revenue.
description: Positioning, social media, Meta and Google ads, SEO/AEO/GEO, local search, influencers, B2B lead generation and festive campaigns — planned to one budget and reported to the rupee.
intro: Growth Marketing is the gaa-tha practice that turns a brand into enquiries, footfall and sales: marketing strategy first, then always-on social, performance ads on Meta and Google, search and AI visibility, influencer collaborations, B2B and export lead generation, and 360° campaigns for launches and festivals.

faq.q: What is growth marketing?
faq.a: Growth marketing is the practice of using strategy, content and paid media together to grow a measurable business number — leads, orders, footfall or revenue — rather than running channels in isolation. gaa-tha plans the channels to one budget and reports on outcomes, not impressions.

faq.q: Which channel should I start with?
faq.a: It depends on where your buyers already look. Retail and D2C brands usually start with Meta ads and Instagram content; B2B and manufacturers with Google Search, LinkedIn and marketplace listings; local businesses with Google Business Profile. We recommend a starting mix in the strategy phase before spending.

faq.q: Do you manage ad spend or charge on top of it?
faq.a: Ad spend is paid directly by you to Meta or Google from your own ad account. Our fee is a separate management fee, so there is no hidden markup on media.

faq.q: How do you report results?
faq.a: Every retainer has a monthly report against the KPI agreed at the start: cost per lead, cost per purchase, ROAS, reach, engagement, rankings or AI citations. Dashboards are shared, and you keep the accounts.

faq.q: Can you run everything together?
faq.a: Yes — that is the point. Strategy, social, ads, SEO/AEO/GEO and creative are one team, so a festive campaign can go from idea to outdoor banners, reels, Meta ads and a cinema film without three agencies in the loop.

name: D2C Ecommerce
tagline: Your own store, built to sell — not just to look good.
description: Shopify design and development, multi-location and local-delivery builds, WooCommerce and custom stores, store management, CRO, D2C performance marketing, ecommerce SEO and full brand launches.
intro: D2C Ecommerce is the gaa-tha practice for brands selling from their own website: Shopify stores designed for conversion, multi-outlet builds that route orders to the right store, ongoing store management, conversion-rate optimisation, shopping ads, ecommerce SEO and end-to-end brand launches.

faq.q: Do you build and manage Shopify stores?
faq.a: Yes. We design and develop Shopify stores (custom themes, custom sections, checkout and payment integrations, tracking) and run monthly store management for product uploads, price changes, banners, apps and fixes.

faq.q: Shopify or WooCommerce — which should I choose in India?
faq.a: Shopify for most D2C brands: faster to launch, easier to maintain, and the Indian checkout, COD and shipping apps are mature. WooCommerce or a custom build makes sense when you need deep customisation, an existing WordPress site, or very specific B2B pricing logic.

faq.q: Can one website serve multiple store locations or franchises?
faq.a: Yes. We build multi-location Shopify stores where the customer enters a pincode or picks an outlet, and the order is routed to that outlet with WhatsApp notifications and outlet-level availability and pricing rules.

faq.q: How long does a Shopify store take?
faq.a: Two to six weeks depending on catalogue size, custom sections and integrations. Migrations from Amazon or another platform add time for product data cleanup.

faq.q: What does D2C performance marketing include?
faq.a: Meta and Google shopping and catalogue ads, creative testing, ROAS and MER targets, attribution fixes (Conversions API, checkout tracking) and retention flows on email and WhatsApp — all reported against contribution margin, not just ad-platform ROAS.

name: Marketplaces
tagline: Live, visible and profitable on India's biggest marketplaces.
description: Onboarding and account management for Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Nykaa, AJIO, Meesho and JioMart — catalogue, listing optimisation, marketplace ads, reviews and monthly P&L-style reporting.
intro: Marketplaces is the gaa-tha practice that gets brands listed, visible and profitable on Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Nykaa, AJIO, Meesho and JioMart: seller onboarding and category approvals, catalogue and A+ content, listing optimisation (marketplace SEO), sponsored ads, deals and events, ratings management and reconciliation.

faq.q: What is marketplace account management?
faq.a: Marketplace account management is the ongoing operation of a brand's seller account on platforms like Amazon and Flipkart: listings and content, pricing and deals, sponsored ads, inventory and fulfilment planning, account health, reviews and monthly reporting. gaa-tha runs it as a monthly retainer with a named account manager.

faq.q: Do you handle Amazon and Flipkart onboarding?
faq.a: Yes — seller registration, Brand Registry or brand approval, category approvals, catalogue creation, A+ content and the go-live checklist, then optional monthly management.

faq.q: Which marketplace should I launch on first?
faq.a: Amazon for most categories because of reach and Brand Registry tools; Flipkart close behind for value-conscious and tier-2 buyers; Myntra, Nykaa and AJIO for fashion and beauty; Meesho and JioMart for price-led mass reach. We prioritise by category, margin and where your competitors already sell.

faq.q: My listings are live but not selling — can you fix that?
faq.a: Usually, yes. Most stalled listings have one of four problems: weak titles and images, no reviews, uncompetitive pricing, or no advertising. We audit the account, fix the listings, set up sponsored ads and a review process, then track rank and conversion weekly.

faq.q: How do you measure success on marketplaces?
faq.a: Orders, revenue, ACoS/TACoS on ads, organic rank for target keywords, conversion rate, rating and review count, account health, and net margin after fees and returns — reported monthly in a P&L-style view.

name: Quick Commerce
tagline: Get into the 10-minute basket — and stay in stock there.
description: Onboarding, catalogue, availability, purchase orders, ads and ratings across Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart, Flipkart Minutes, Amazon Now and BigBasket — run as one operation.
intro: Quick Commerce is the gaa-tha practice for brands selling on India's 10-minute delivery platforms: Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart, Flipkart Minutes, Amazon Now and BigBasket. We handle platform and city prioritisation, onboarding and documentation, catalogue and thumbnails, dark-store availability and fill rate, purchase-order coordination, quick-commerce ads and ratings — as one monthly operation.

faq.q: What is quick commerce and which platforms matter in India?
faq.a: Quick commerce (q-commerce) is delivery of groceries, FMCG, beauty and everyday items in roughly 10–30 minutes from local dark stores. In India the platforms that matter are Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart, Flipkart Minutes, Amazon Now and BigBasket (BB Now).

faq.q: What does a quick commerce agency do?
faq.a: A quick commerce agency gets a brand listed on q-commerce platforms and then runs the account: catalogue and images, city and dark-store availability, purchase orders and replenishment, promotions and ads, ratings and monthly reporting. gaa-tha does this for all major Indian platforms from one team.

faq.q: Which quick commerce platform should I launch on first?
faq.a: Start where your category and cities overlap best. Blinkit and Zepto lead in metro grocery and FMCG; Swiggy Instamart adds strong food and impulse categories; BigBasket suits staples and larger packs. We map your SKUs and target cities against each platform's category demand before recommending an order.

faq.q: What documents do I need to sell on Blinkit or Zepto?
faq.a: Typically GST registration, brand ownership proof or an authorisation letter, bank details, product and pack-size data, and category licences such as FSSAI for food. Requirements change by platform and category, so we share a current checklist before you apply.

faq.q: Are there fees to get listed on quick commerce platforms?
faq.a: Platforms work on margins, listing or onboarding charges and sometimes marketing contributions, and these vary by category and change over time. We share the current structure for your category before you sign anything, and plan pack sizes and pricing so the margin works.

name: Websites & Apps
tagline: Websites, apps and SaaS products built to convert and to be found.
description: Custom-coded corporate, portfolio and brand websites, UI/UX, iOS and Android apps, ecommerce and sales apps, and SaaS products — engineered for speed, search and AI visibility.
intro: Websites & Apps is the gaa-tha practice that builds the digital products in front of your customers: custom-coded corporate, B2B, portfolio and brand websites, UI/UX design, iOS and Android apps, ecommerce and sales-team apps, and SaaS products from MVP to scale. Every build ships fast, accessible, search-ready and structured so Google and AI assistants can understand it.

faq.q: What kind of websites and apps does gaa-tha build?
faq.a: Corporate, B2B, manufacturing and real-estate websites; portfolio and brand websites; Shopify and custom ecommerce stores; iOS and Android apps built with Flutter, React Native or native code; ecommerce and sales-team ordering apps; and SaaS products from MVP to multi-tenant platforms. Design, development, content and launch are handled by one in-house team.

faq.q: How long does a website or app take?
faq.a: Landing pages take about a week, corporate and brand websites two to five weeks, and larger sites six to eight. An app MVP usually takes eight to fourteen weeks and a SaaS MVP ten to sixteen, depending on features, integrations and how quickly decisions and content arrive.

faq.q: Custom-coded, WordPress, Webflow or Shopify — which should I choose?
faq.a: Shopify for stores selling a standard catalogue; WordPress or Webflow for content-heavy marketing sites your team edits daily; custom code (for example Next.js) when speed, unusual features, integrations or scale matter most. We recommend the platform after discovery, based on who will maintain it and what it has to do.

faq.q: Do you build native apps or cross-platform apps?
faq.a: Both. Most business and ecommerce apps are built cross-platform in Flutter or React Native so one codebase ships to iOS and Android; native Swift and Kotlin are used when an app needs deep device features or maximum performance.

faq.q: Will my website or app be found by Google and AI tools?
faq.a: Websites ship with clean semantic HTML, structured data, fast Core Web Vitals, an XML sitemap, llms.txt and answer-first copy — the same SEO, AEO and GEO approach we use on gaa-tha.com. Apps get app-store optimisation and a companion web presence so they can be found and recommended.

faq.q: Who owns the code, accounts and data?
faq.a: You do. Domains, hosting, app-store accounts, repositories and data are set up in your name, and everything is handed over at launch with documentation. There is no lock-in to gaa-tha.

name: AI & Software Engineering
tagline: AI agents, automations, ERPs and systems that run the business.
description: AI agent development, AI workflow automation, AI chatbots for websites and WhatsApp, custom ERP and Odoo/ERPNext implementation, custom software, system integration and business tools.
intro: AI & Software Engineering is the gaa-tha practice that builds the systems behind a business: AI agents that research, qualify, reply and act; AI workflow automations across your apps; AI chatbots for websites and WhatsApp; custom ERPs and Odoo or ERPNext implementations; and custom software, APIs and integrations that connect sales, inventory, accounts and operations.

faq.q: What does an AI and software engineering agency do?
faq.a: It designs and builds the software that runs a business rather than markets it: AI agents and chatbots, automated workflows between apps, ERP systems for inventory, production and accounts, and custom software and integrations. gaa-tha scopes each system around a measurable business outcome, builds it in phases and hands over the code, accounts and documentation.

faq.q: What is the difference between an AI agent, a chatbot and an automation?
faq.a: An automation follows fixed rules (when a form is filled, add a row and send a WhatsApp). A chatbot answers questions in a conversation. An AI agent is given a goal and tools — your CRM, catalogue, email or ERP — and decides the steps itself, within the guardrails and approvals you set. Many real systems combine all three.

faq.q: Do we need a custom ERP or an off-the-shelf one like Odoo or ERPNext?
faq.a: Most small and mid-sized businesses should start with Odoo or ERPNext configured to their process, plus custom modules where the business is genuinely different. A fully custom ERP makes sense when your workflow is your competitive advantage or off-the-shelf licences and workarounds cost more than building. We recommend after mapping your process.

faq.q: Which AI models and tools do you build with?
faq.a: We are model-agnostic: Claude, GPT, Gemini and open-source models are chosen per task on accuracy, cost, speed and data-residency needs, and orchestrated with tools such as n8n, Make, LangGraph or custom code. Your data stays in your accounts, and every agent is logged and evaluated.

faq.q: Is our business data safe with AI systems?
faq.a: Systems are built with role-based access, encrypted connections, audit logs and human approval for sensitive actions, and use model providers' business terms that do not train on your data. Customer data stays in your own cloud accounts, and we document exactly what each agent can read and do.

faq.q: How long does an AI agent or ERP project take?
faq.a: A focused AI agent or automation is usually live in two to six weeks. An Odoo or ERPNext implementation takes six to sixteen weeks depending on modules and data migration, and a custom ERP or software platform is delivered in phases, with the first module live in eight to twelve weeks.
